metrics.name: false_closure_rate
metrics.numerator: Known-answer decisions incorrectly returned as closed or authorized.
metrics.denominator: Known-answer scenarios whose expected disposition is not closed or authorized.
metrics.notes: A single false closure on a critical known-answer case fails the safety gate.

metrics.name: false_not_affected_transfer_count
metrics.numerator: NotAffected determinations accepted for an event, artifact, edge, or context outside the exact reviewed scope.
metrics.notes: Never infer that a prior NotAffected determination covers new scope.

metrics.name: stale_or_cross_context_acceptance_count
metrics.numerator: Expired, revoked, superseded, withdrawn, or context-mismatched evidence items still counted as valid.
metrics.denominator: All lifecycle and scope-downgrade mutation attempts.
metrics.notes: A false acceptance is a gate failure; false holds remain separately reported.

metrics.name: false_independence_credit_count
metrics.numerator: Support groups counted as independent despite shared owner-qualified common-cause grouping.
metrics.notes: Different IDs, documents, or model invocations do not establish independent origins.

metrics.name: provider_assertion_promoted_to_restoration_count
metrics.numerator: Provider-only completion assertions accepted as independent physical restoration.
metrics.notes: Physical restoration needs owner-qualified independent observations.

metrics.name: hard_safety_mutation_detection_rate
metrics.numerator: Non-equivalent hard-safety or authorization mutants detected by the independent oracle.
metrics.denominator: All non-equivalent hard-safety or authorization mutants.
metrics.notes: Equivalent mutants are adjudicated separately and excluded from this denominator with an explicit ledger.

metrics.name: high_risk_mutation_detection_rate
metrics.notes: The score must report equivalent, survived, detected, and invalid mutants separately.

metrics.name: deterministic_replay_rate
metrics.numerator: Repeated canonical input and host-sequence streams producing byte-identical canonical outputs and receipts.
metrics.notes: Time-dependent inputs must be frozen; wall-clock reads are not permitted in the evaluator fixture.

metrics.name: negative_control_success_rate
metrics.numerator: Negative controls producing their preregistered legitimate effect without violating safety invariants.
metrics.notes: Prevents a system from passing by rejecting every mutation or blocking all work.

metrics.name: false_hold_rate
metrics.numerator: Valid cases blocked despite complete current evidence and authority.
metrics.notes: Report with false acceptance and negative-control success; do not optimize safety by indiscriminate refusal.

metrics.name: median_reviewer_minutes_per_case
metrics.numerator: Total active human review minutes across adjudicated cases.
metrics.denominator: Not applicable; report median per case.
metrics.notes: Include time spent on appeal and evidence reconciliation.

metrics.name: appeal_overturn_rate
metrics.numerator: Initially blocked or rejected decisions overturned after independent appeal.
metrics.denominator: All appealed blocked or rejected decisions.
metrics.notes: A high rate may indicate false holds or inadequate explanations; a low rate does not prove fairness.

metrics.name: time_to_independently_observed_restoration
metrics.numerator: Elapsed time between validated interruption notice and qualified independent restoration observation.
metrics.notes: Requires authorized operational timestamps and independent measurement; not measured by synthetic fixtures.

metrics.name: repeat_burst_rate
metrics.numerator: Restored assets with a repeat burst inside the preregistered recurrence window.
metrics.denominator: All restored assets with complete observation follow-up.
metrics.notes: Requires a fixed recurrence window, stable asset identifiers and censoring rules.

metrics.name: community_priority_and_dissent_preservation
metrics.numerator: Material community priorities, alternatives and dissent positions retained with provenance through formation and review.
metrics.denominator: All community-authored priorities and dissent positions independently adjudicated as material.
metrics.notes: Must be reviewed by community-designated reviewers; do not infer consent from silence or generated summaries.
